privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: SchulKompass NRW is built so that parents can search without an account and without leaving traces.
privacy.noAccountBody: The school search requires no sign-in. We collect no names, no email addresses and no usage profiles from parents.
privacy.cookiesBody: No marketing or analytics cookies are set. A single cookie is used for school staff sign-in and it is httpOnly and secure.
privacy.locationBody: If you use location search, your position is sent only to our EU server for the radius query and is never stored.
privacy.mapBody: Map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap only after your explicit confirmation.
privacy.hostingBody: Application and database run in the European Union (Frankfurt region).

footer.openData: School data is based on open data published by the state of North Rhine-Westphalia.
